headerDisplay:
Exposes one HomeKit switch per qBittorrent server, toggling that server's **alternative speed limits**.

Enable the Web UI on every server you add (*Tools → Options → Web UI*).
footerDisplay:
A switch is tied to its server's URL, so you can rename a server without losing its HomeKit room, scenes or automations.

Having trouble? See the [README](https://github.com/RauchenwaldC/homebridge-qbittorrent-plugin?tab=readme-ov-file#qbittorrent-homebridge-plugin) or open an [issue](https://github.com/RauchenwaldC/homebridge-qbittorrent-plugin/issues).

name.title: Name
name.description: The switch name in the Home app. Give each server a different name.

apiUrl.title: Web UI URL
apiUrl.description: Address of the qBittorrent Web UI, including the port.

username.title: Username
username.description: Leave empty if this server does not require authentication.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave empty if this server does not require authentication.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to re-read each server, so changes made in qBittorrent itself reach the Home app.

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for a server to respond before giving up.
